questions.question:
Which of the following is an example of reported speech? 
A) She says she will come.
B) He claims that he knows English well.
C) I told him I would meet him at 6 pm.
D) They suggest we should stay late.

Which sentence is in the passive voice? 
A) The students read a book.
B) A new film by the director has been released.
C) He likes to watch soccer matches.
D) They are travelling around Europe.

Which advanced conditional expression is used in the sentence? 
A) If she had studied harder, she would have passed.
B) She will be angry if you don't help her.
C) He could make a mistake when he was younger.
D) We should use more natural language in our reports.

Which discourse marker indicates a change of topic? 
A) Therefore
B) In other words
C) However
D) Moreover

Which collocation is used incorrectly? 
A) a five-star hotel
B) put up with someone
C) I'm going to the store
D) dress up as

Which dependent preposition is used incorrectly? 
A) on top of
B) because of
C) due to the fact that
D) except for

Which word precisely choice is used? 
A) Their friend was feeling tired because they had been working hard.
B) If he could help you, he would do so.
C) She likes to read books that have intriguing plots.
D) They decided not to go out as it was raining heavily.

Which of the following is an accurate translation of 'It's likely that he will join us.'? 
A) It seems probable that he would come.
B) Therefore it looks like I should go too.
C) It is possible that we could meet him later.
D) It appears plausible that he might accompany us.

Which grammatical error is present in the sentence? 
A) He was surprised that he had been forgotten.
B) She feels a bit sad because it's raining today.
C) The company has decided not to close its offices during the summer.
D) They will try their best to make me happy.

Which sentence uses a more precise vocabulary choice? 
A) The restaurant was quite busy.
B) He's not very good at dancing.
C) I have many friends in this city.
D) It took me an hour to finish the task.
